Information for doctoral candidates, applicants, and supervisors in physics, chemistry, and biosciences
At a glance
This portal explains the formal steps toward a doctorate at the
TUM School of Natural Sciences: admission, supervision, membership in
Graduate Center NAT, the qualification program, thesis submission, examination,
and the publication of the doctoral thesis.
Useful German terms: Promotion, Dissertation, Promotionsordnung,
Promotionsverfahren, Betreuungsvereinbarung, Doktorand, Doktorandin.
Finding the right information
I am planning a doctorate
Start here if you are interested in a doctorate at the TUM School of Natural
Sciences and want to understand the requirements, the application process, or the
recognition of a degree from outside Germany.

Helping to improve this information
These pages are continuously updated, refined, and expanded. If you are
missing information on the formal steps toward a doctorate in the natural
sciences, or if you have suggestions for improvement, please contact us at
promotion@nat.tum.de.
Glossary
To support both German and international doctoral candidates, we provide an
English and German glossary with important terms related to
doctoral studies, including Promotion, supervisor (Doktormutter,
Doktorvater), doctoral thesis (Doktorarbeit), and other administrative
terms.
